component.name: PolyCodex
component.summary: Universal 1:1 layout and image preserving PDF translator supporting up to 5000 pages

description.p: PolyCodex is a universal, open-source PDF translator that treats document layout, vector graphics, and image integrity as first-class constraints.

ul.li: 1:1 Preservation: Images (Do operators), vector lines, tables, and bounding boxes are untouched.
Dynamic Micro-Typography: Adjusts character scaling (Tz operator) to prevent target language overflow.
5000 Pages Streaming: Memory-bounded processing for massive technical manuals and books.
Offline AI: First-class integration with Ollama (Llama 3, Qwen 2.5), LibreTranslate, and LM Studio.
Single-Instance Lock: OS-level concurrency lock prevents process collisions.

description.p: Initial release of PolyCodex featuring 1-1 layout preservation, dynamic Tz scaling, and Ollama integration.
